Image 1: Five-panel storyboard reference, used for the overall shot structure, shot sizes, and camera-movement rhythm. Read it from left to right and from top to bottom; panel N is Shot N. It is a line-art sketch: do not adopt its sketch style, black outlines, white background, panel borders or drawn faces.
Image 2: Reference of JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, a rendered set, not live action. Use it only for the room's layout, the furniture's positions and the light's direction; do not reference its visual content. It contains no people.
Image 3: Reference of JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 4: Reference of JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 5: Reference of JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 6: Reference of JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 7: Blocking reference of the segment's start: the same place with these people in their places, used only for where each person is and which way they face; take faces and outfits from each subject's own image. It is a line-art diagram: do not adopt its outlines or white background.
Image 8: Subject 1 (Ji Ran, look S0) character appearance reference.
Image 9: Prop 1 (coffee) maps to this image; copy its writing and badges exactly from Image 9.
Image 10: Prop 2 (pour-over coffee equipment) maps to this image; copy its writing and badges exactly from Image 10.
From each prop's image, use only structure, material, and color.
[Subject settings]
Subject 1 (Ji Ran): Refer to Image 8. 27, Heroine; owner of Jiejian Company, daughter of Ji Hongyuan, and ex-girlfriend of Lu Shaoze. Outfit: look S0: Office, day one: a fitted dove-grey silk shirt with the top buttons open to a modest V, tucked into a black high-waisted bodycon pencil skirt that cinches the waist and ends just above the knee. Red pointed-toe stiletto pumps. Diamond studs and a slim gold watch. Signature colour: red.
Environment (JI RAN'S OFFICE): Refer to Images 2 to 6. Day, bright soft daylight through floor-to-ceiling windows. Bright soft daylight from behind the desk, warm recessed ceiling spots and the brass desk lamp. Live sound: a quiet office hum and the porcelain cup touching wood.
Do not swap the characters' appearances, clothing, actions, positions or dialogue.
[Overall style]
Photorealistic live-action short drama with cinematic lighting. Each character keeps the face and the outfit with its main colour from their reference image throughout. Use each character sheet only for that character: the face from the close-up on the right, the body and outfit from the turnaround on the left; do not render the sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. This segment has 1 line, in this order: Ji Ran (V.O.). Generate speech only from the lines in {} in the shot list, each spoken exactly once by its speaker; everyone else keeps their mouth naturally closed while listening, and a V.O. speaker keeps their mouth closed or is off screen. Follow the shot list below; do not add cuts or camera moves beyond it. Strictly adhere to the 180-degree rule: within a scene, characters keep their screen sides and the camera stays on one side of the axis. Seamless continuity of action, spatial matching and consistent actor blocking; cut on action. For dialogue prefer static shot-reverse-shot and over-the-shoulder shots, balanced with reaction shots and close-up inserts. Faces stable and clear, with no resemblance to any real actor or actress. Normal human eyes. Natural anatomy and hands. Natural, fluid motion that follows the blocking; characters make subtle, natural movements. Characters, props and environment share one world with matched lighting. Each line ends naturally with breathing room and is never cut off. Authentic performances with micro-expressions. No BGM; generate only dialogue, environmental sounds and action sounds. No subtitles.
[Strictly exclude]
subtitles or on-screen text. Ji Ran's lips moving during the voice-over. Dialogue from the wrong character, multiple people speaking at once, repeated or missing lines, lip-sync errors and audio-visual desynchronization. The raw reference images (character sheets, setting plates) appearing as a frame of the video, and starting on a still frame of the setting reference. A fast zoom-in at the start, a fast pull-back at the end, unmotivated whip-pans, tilts, zooms and 360-degree orbits. Axis-crossing, jump cuts, frame skips, flicker and clipping. Characters or props popping in or vanishing, and duplicate characters except mirror reflections. Subtitles, captions, watermarks and garbled writing; writing and logos other than those on a key prop's reference image, which are copied from it; a phone screen or paper that is not a key prop is shown from the back or out of focus. Black-and-white, monochrome, grayscale, desaturated visuals; hand-drawn, sketch, line art, illustration, comics, animation; storyboard frames, rough sketches, panel borders, gutters and grid layouts.
[Shot list] (5 shots, approximately 17 seconds)
When a previous-shot reference image is given, it is the moment this segment starts from: keep its people's positions, outfits, props and light, and continue from there. Shot 1 keeps its own camera, matching the image's framing only when it frames the same view; do not repeat that frame later.
At the start: Ji Ran stands behind the walnut desk, in front of the black leather executive chair, her back to the floor-to-ceiling windows and facing the office door. She holds the white coffee cup of black coffee near her lips. The pour-over set stands in the middle of the desk among the architectural plans, wood samples and one metal figurine. The camera is in front of the desk, on the office door side, and stays on that side.
Shot 1 (0-2s): [Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the office door side] Ji Ran raises the white coffee cup to her lips and sips. <a soft sip>
Shot 2 (2-6s): [Medium shot, slow push in on Ji Ran from in front of the desk, eye-level] Ji Ran lowers the cup with her mouth closed, staring past the office door with the windows bright behind her. Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, intimate, bitter): {五年前，纪宏远逼走路少泽，让我跟陈家联姻。}
Shot 3 (6-10s): [Extreme close-up insert, high angle on the desk] Ji Ran sets the white coffee cup down hard beside the glass server, and the coffee ripples. Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, bitter): {现在路少泽发达了，又迫不及待悔婚，}
Shot 4 (10-12s): [Medium close-up, low angle from the desk edge] Ji Ran's eyes narrow with her mouth closed, and her hand stays on the cup. Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, scornful): {把我塞给路少泽。}
Shot 5 (12-17s): [Close-up, slow push in to her eyes, eye-level] Ji Ran's gaze hardens into cold resolve, her mouth firmly closed. Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, cold, cutting): {在他眼里，我永远都只是一个待价而沽的工具。}
At the end: Ji Ran stands behind the walnut desk, in front of the executive chair, her back to the windows. Her hand rests beside the white coffee cup on the desk, and her gaze is hard and fixed toward the office door.
